thread:
maria: Deployed mixed-precision kernel selector to prod an hour ago. Seeing ~18% P99 latency increase on long-prefix (>8k tokens) workloads and intermittent Inf/NaN spikes in runtime logs. Filing here for triage.

deploy-bot: Deployed runtime v2.14.3-mp-selector to cluster prod-1 at 2025-11-03T14:02:00Z
ajay: Quick log excerpt: `ERROR runtime: kv_rescale: computed scale=0.0 -> producing Inf in subsequent qkv matmul` — appears with model xglm-20b-int4 on sequences ~10k-12k.
sophie: perf-bot link: https://perf-bot/reports/1951234000 — hot path points to `int4_mha_fast` for seq>4096. Fallback selector is flipping between int4 and fp8 kernels intermittently which might explain instability.
perf-bot: profile summary: gpu kernel time (long prefix) shifted: 34ms -> 45ms, dispatcher CPU up ~12%. Batch sizes unchanged.
kevin: Hypothesis: smoothquant calibration (alpha=0.7) reduces per-channel scales in later layers. Combined with int4 packing for mha we hit underflow/zero-scale corner case and `kv_rescale` assumes non-zero scale.
ajay: Repro snippet I used locally: ```python
# repro loop
ctx = Client().open('xglm-20b-int4')
for i in range(0, 12000, 64):
    out = ctx.generate(max_new_tokens=16)
    # watch logs: NaN count increments after layer 28
```
maria: Repro confirmed in staging: NaNs consistently appear right after `kv_cache_rescale(layer=28)`. Turning off rescale removes NaNs but memory + latency go up.
sophie: Immediate mitigation idea: change selector rule so for prefix_len>4096 we force `fp8_mha_stable` instead of `int4_mha_fast`. Less throughput but safer.
kevin: Also try activation clipping before quant: `x = clamp(x, -clip_val, clip_val)` (clip_val ~ 8-12) to avoid large outliers blowing up integer quant paths.
ajay: I pushed a quick patch: lower smoothquant alpha -> 0.5 and add guard in `kv_rescale`: if scale==0 or not isfinite(scale) then recompute scale = max(eps, fallback_scale). In stress tests NaN count -> 0.
maria: We should canary these together: selector change + rescale guard + alpha tweak. Can we do 5% canary?
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: 5% traffic -> prod-1 pool with flags: selector.force_fp8_threshold=4096, rescale.guard=true, smoothquant.alpha=0.5
perf-bot: Canary early metrics (15m): p99 latency down ~9% relative to problematic rollout; NaN/error logs dropped to 0/15m; GPU util +2%.
sophie: :thumbsup: I'll file a follow-up perf regression ticket to schedule a calibration sweep for int4 kernels vs fp8 on long prefixes. We need better per-layer diagnostics in the selector.
kevin: Action items: 1) run calibration sweep (alpha grid) on representative workloads, 2) add unit tests for zero-scale in `kv_rescale`, 3) evaluate disabling int4_mha_fast for sequences >8k until kernels hardened.
maria: Thanks team — monitoring dashboards up. If canary stays clean for 2 hours we roll to 100%. Will post final status.
